Name: Uzziel, of the Sons of Jeduthun
Summary: Uzziel, of the sons of Jeduthun, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Shemaiah, of the Sons of Jeduthun; King Hezekiah; Jeduthun
LifeLesson: A clean house prepared the way for renewed praise.
